query:
UPDATE "Webhook" SET
               name = COALESCE($2, name),
               url = COALESCE($3, url),
               secret = COALESCE($4, secret),
               scopes = COALESCE($5, scopes),
               events = COALESCE($6, events),
               active = COALESCE($7, active),
               "updatedAt" = $8
           WHERE id = $1
